The must have app for every Airfryer owner.

In this app you will find the best baking times for your Airfryer. From Flemish fries, frikandellen and bitterballen to salmon biscuits and cakes.

Each baking time describes how long and how hot you should configure your Airfryer. You can also see which brand the products are from, and whether it is best to put them frozen or unfrozen in your Airfryer.

You can give your favourite baking times a star to put it in the favourites section. You will never have to search for the right baking time again.

Do you have a product that is not in the list, or that you would like to prepare a little longer or shorter? Then you can also add your own baking times.

Calculated Cakes will help you find the perfect cake for any occasion or any client. Quickly view different tier combinations, find cutting guides, serving counts, and more. 

App Features:
• Calculate the perfect cake for any occasion, whether you're looking for stacked tiers, or individual cakes
• Build or edit cakes manually in the Stacker with tiers, dummy tiers, boards, and columns (columns require a Pro upgrade)
• View and edit your cakes with support for changing colors, offsetting tiers, and rotatable tiers
• View your cakes in augmented reality! (iOS device with a minimum of an A9 processor required)
• Get automatic calculations of fondant amounts needed for any cake or cake board
• View and share cutting guides for all of your cakes in either Straight-Cut, or the more traditional Concentric-Cut styles
• Customize the settings of the app to suit your needs as a cake professional or home user


Calculated Cakes is available in three different levels:
Free: 
• Includes Square and Sheet cake shapes, cake boards, and all editing capabilities for these shapes
• Contains serving charts, fondant amounts, and cutting guides for ALL shapes that the app supports in the Pro version. So you can still get the info you need even in the Free level.

Basic (upgrade required):
• Includes Round, Square, and Sheet cake shapes
• Adds a History tab for viewing previous cakes
• Removes the upgrade tab

Pro (upgrade required):
• Includes Round, Square, Heart, Hexagon, Oval, Petal (in 5, 6, and 8-petal varieties), and Sheet cake shapes
• Adds cake columns, available from 1 to 10 columns, and any number in between
• Adds a mixed-shape stacked calculator for calculating cakes with multiple tier shapes
• Automatically gets upgraded with any new Pro features that get added in future versions
